items.text: 1/4 Congresswoman Jackson Lee has been working on the Medicaid 1115 Waiver for many years and has been working very hard with the Biden Administration for the solution now in 2022, to help suffering hospitals who serve indigent patients that have not been able to access Medicaid.

2/4  The state of Texas has steadfastly stood against hospitals and indigent patients by not accepting the expanded Medicaid, and fought every step to deny poor people healthcare in this state. Soon, I expect a positive announcement from the Biden administration, of whom I

3/4 applaud wholeheartedly with great excitement that they have chosen concern for hardworking poor over politics, for the people of the state of Texas.

I'm hoping that decision comes shortly to give relief to all of our hospitals, including our rural and urban hospitals,

4/4 serving poor Texans. Poor Texans should not be shut out from the healthcare system. Access to good healthcare saves lives. 

Thank you, President Biden! Thank you, Vice President Harris! Let me say it again. Thank you, President Joe Biden!

I have fought consistently for Texas, which has the highest number of uninsured residents to have better healthcare.

This bill will provide additional subsidies for working families so that they can have access to the Affordable Care Act to have better healthcare for them and their children. In addition, we worked hard to reduce the cost of insulin to be capped at $35 dollars.

Our hospitals are suffering, and we must fix the Medicaid gap and implement expanded Medicaid for the hospitals in Texas.  This bill will help real people in real time.  It is urgent that we pass this legislation to reduce inflation.  I will be pushing for its passage!
